description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Sanitizer' utility class, specifically testing the SVG sanitization for security vulnerabilities such as embedded scripts, inline event handlers, and malformed SVGs.

classes.name: SanitizerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the Sanitizer utility, testing SVG input sanitization to prevent XSS attacks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating instances of Sanitizer and DOMDocument.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithScriptTag
methods.description: Tests sanitization of SVG containing a script tag to ensure scripts are removed.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithOnClick
methods.description: Tests sanitization of SVG with an inline 'onclick' event to verify removal attributes.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithAnimate
methods.description: Tests sanitization of SVG with an animate element that contains scripting-like attributes.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithRegularSVG
methods.description: Verifies that a well-formed, safe SVG remains unchanged after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithBadlyFormattedSVG
methods.description: Expects an exception when sanitizing a malformed SVG input.
